      • loadEmbeddedLanguages

        protected void loadEmbeddedLanguages()
        This will load every LanguagePreset into memory. To be precise: It performs addLanguage(String, String) for every value of LanguagePreset.

      • getStringOrDefault

        @ParametersAreNonnullByDefault
 @Nullable
public java.lang.String getStringOrDefault(Language language,
                                                                                     LanguageFile file,
                                                                                     java.lang.String path)
        Per-language message read with an English fallback, for callers that only have a Language (no Player) - e.g. a boot-time precompute running on the Netty-safe path. Unlike getMessage(Player, String), this never touches a Player. Public (not package-private): LocalizationService, the concrete subclass returned by Slimefun.getLocalization(), lives in a different package and would not inherit a default-access member declared here.
